title: Definitions of soul-diseases nine through fifteen
english: Ecstasy is a bending again toward vice of the rational soul, after virtue and the knowledge of God.
Crushing is a most wicked disposition of the rational soul, by which it pursues the virtues not because of the beautiful itself.
Docking of the nose is a deprivation of the virtue that takes in the fragrance of Christ.
Cutting off of the ear is a hardness of the rational soul that drags it back from spiritual teaching.
A freckle is a falling away from spiritual contemplation, or an untrue comprehension of the contemplation of the things that have come to be.
Difficulty of speech is a passion of the rational soul, by which it is scandalized at what happens and is unable to give thanks to God in everything.
Lameness is an inability of the rational nature for the work of virtue.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Evagrius continues his numbered definitions of spiritual diseases of the rational soul, moving from ecstasy and crushing to mutilation, deafness, freckle, speech-difficulty, and lameness.

title: Dropsy and the symbolic animals of spiritual progress
english: Dropsy is an irrational turning away of the soul, in which vice and ignorance prevail once the virtues have been quenched.
An ant is a practical man who prepares his own food in this age.
Rock badgers are unclean nations that have received the commandments of our Savior Christ.
Unruled locusts are rational souls that are not shaken by death and are fed by seeds.
A gecko is a practical mind that leans on virtues and dwells in the knowledge of the heavenly powers.
A lion cub is a man free from passions who has ruled the beasts within him.
A rooster is a spiritual man who is filled with knowledge and proclaims to other souls the day that has come from the intelligible sun.
A he-goat is a practical man who rightly leads the disordered thoughts within him.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Evagrius continues his list of spiritual diseases and then begins a series of symbolic animals and natural figures representing practitioners at different stages of spiritual progress.

title: Unclean Powers, False Knowledge, and Holy Powers
english: A leech is an unclean power that sucks the righteous blood out of rational souls.
Hades is ignorance that comes upon a rational nature through the deprivation of the contemplation of God.
A woman is folly that summons rational souls to uncleanness.
Earth is a most wicked disposition gathered together from impiety and lawlessness.
Fire is a vice of rational nature that destroys the virtues of God.
Water is false knowledge that extinguishes true knowledge.
A mocking eye is an unclean power that mocks the knowledge of God and dishonors the wisdom in created things.
Ravens are holy powers that destroy vices.
Ravines are rational souls hollowed out by vice and ignorance.
Eaglets are holy powers entrusted with casting down the unclean.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Evagrius continues his symbolic definitions, now listing unclean powers, false knowledge, and holy powers that oppose or destroy vices.
